messages:
maria: FYI we're kicking off the alpha bundle pricing experiment tomorrow. Need cutover checklist + grandfathering rules for legacy subs.
ajay: Can we stagger by customer size? small -> med -> large over 3 days to reduce invoice shock.
samir: Agree. Also vendor sheet needs updated mapping for embedded units. @maria can you approve the pass-through mapping?
maria: Uploaded vendor-sheet v2 here: https://drive.redwood/example. Approve mapping for alpha only. Suggest exempt customers with credits > $1000.
jen_prod: Product wants A/B split 20/80 for the new price path (control=old, treatment=new). Need flag + rollout window and rollout doc.
ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: scheduled job created for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC (canary run) :white_check_mark: 
ajay: Quick billing question — invoices that span old/new pricing dates: pro-rate by usage timestamp or by invoice date?
maria: Pro-rate by usage timestamp. Grandfather customers with subscriptions created before cutoff; keep old price for 30 days post-cutover.
samir: I'll generate an exceptions list. Exporting eligible accounts now and will post CSV.
jen_prod: If we see >5% billing delta in canary, auto-rollback to control set and alert finance@squad.
maria: :thumbsup: Approving that. Who signs off on vendor fee passthrough? @vendor-ops?
vendor-ops: vendor-ops: confirm margin passthrough is ok but need SKU mapping and contract clause.
samir: Uploading SKU mapping now. Reconciliation runbook snippet below for reference:

```
SELECT account_id, SUM(tokens) as total_tokens FROM usage
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-04-01' AND '2026-04-04'
GROUP BY account_id;
```

Compare totals to billing export and vendor report.
ajay: Gate canary to 50 customers for 24h. Maria to approve list by EOD.
maria: List shared in doc (alpha_canary_list.csv). Approving canary. Post any invoice mismatches here and tag #billing-escalations.
jen_prod: Noted — I'll coordinate the feature flag timeline with platform and send the rollout window.
ops-bot: incident-bot: if >100 invoices fail reconciliation within 2h, auto-escalate to oncall.
samir: One more ask — ensure reporting includes both pre_price and post_price columns for audit and downstream billing analytics.
maria: Will add columns to CFO report template and notify accounting. Thanks team.
